info.title: CareNear API
info.description: CareNear backend API — Plateforme de mise en relation patients / infirmiers à domicile.

post.description: Authenticates user by phone number, revokes any previous tokens, and returns a new Sanctum Bearer token.

message.example: As a PATIENT, you've successfully connected.

post.description: Revokes the current Sanctum token. Requires authentication.

get.summary: Get current authenticated user with profile
get.description: Returns the authenticated user data. If NURSE, includes nurseProfile. If PATIENT, includes patientProfile.

post.summary: Register a new user (PATIENT or NURSE)
post.description: Creates a new account and returns a Sanctum Bearer token. No authentication required.

422.description: Validation error (phone taken, passwords don't match, etc.)

get.summary: Get audit logs with filters and pagination
get.description: Returns a paginated list of audit logs. Supports filtering by action, actor_user_id, request_id, entity_type, entity_id, and date range (from/to).

get.summary: List care requests with filters and pagination

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by care request status (e.g., pending, accepted, completed)

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Filter care requests created from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Filter care requests created up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page for pagination (default: 20, max: 50)

200.description: Successful response with paginated care requests

get.summary: Get messages for a care request

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of messages to return (default: 200, max: 500)

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: Return messages with ID greater than this value (for pagination)

200.description: Successful response with list of messages

get.summary: List nurse profiles (filterable by verified status)
get.description: ADMIN only. Returns paginated nurse profiles.

post.description: ADMIN only. Sets the verified flag on a nurse profile. Admin should review the uploaded diploma before verifying.

get.summary: Get list of users with optional filters

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query to match against full name, phone, or email

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of users to return per page (default: 20, max: 50)

200.description: Successful response with paginated list of users

get.summary: List care requests for current user
get.description: PATIENT: returns own requests. NURSE: returns assigned + nearby open BROADCAST + open TARGETED (to self). ADMIN: all.

post.description: PATIENT only. Supports BROADCAST (default) or TARGETED (to a specific verified nurse).
NURSE only. For TARGETED, only the targeted nurse can accept.
NURSE only. Only for open BROADCAST requests.
PATIENT only. Allowed statuses: PENDING or ACCEPTED.
NURSE only. Allowed status: ACCEPTED. Marks it as DONE.

post.summary: Rebook based on a previous care request
post.description: PATIENT only. Only allowed when original request is DONE. Can rebook as TARGETED (same nurse) or BROADCAST.

get.summary: List last messages for a care request

post.summary: Send a message in care request chat
post.description: Chat is available only after ACCEPTED (or DONE). Contact sharing is masked and triggers a warning.

get.description: NURSE downloads own diploma. ADMIN can specify ?user_id=XX to download any nurse's diploma. Returns the binary file.
Returns up to 50 verified nurses within the given radius, sorted by distance. Includes average rating and review count.
PATIENT downloads own document by index. ADMIN can specify ?user_id=XX. Returns binary file.
Returns the patient profile of the authenticated user including medical documents metadata. Returns null data if no profile exists.

post.summary: Create or update patient profile (with optional medical documents upload)
post.description: PATIENT only. Uses multipart/form-data when uploading files. Maximum 5 files per request, 10 total. Accepted formats: PDF, JPG, PNG (max 5MB each).

medical_files[].description: Medical documents (PDF/JPG/PNG, max 5MB each, max 5 files)

403.description: Forbidden — user is not a PATIENT

delete.description: PATIENT only. Deletes the medical document at the given index. Index is 0-based as returned by GET /patient/profile.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: 0-based index of the document to delete

post.summary: Submit a review for a completed care request
post.description: PATIENT only. Only allowed after status is DONE. One review per care request.

403.description: Forbidden — not the patient or not PATIENT role

409.description: Review already exists for this request

422.description: Request is not DONE or has no nurse

get.description: No authentication required. Returns paginated reviews.

get.summary: Get aggregated rating for a nurse (public)
get.description: No authentication required. Returns average rating and total review count.

bearerAuth.description: Use Sanctum token as Bearer token
